title: Referential Regimes: Transformation-Based Identity Profiles for Neutral Substrates
abstract: arXiv:2601.16152v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Data systems operating under persistent legal, institutional, and analytic disagreement require shared reference without presupposing agreement about interpretation. This paper investigates identity preservation under transformation, building on the conditional neutrality result of Neutral Substrates (arXiv:2601.14271).   We pair candidate identity bases with families of record transformations and classify each family as preserving, breaking, neutral, or inapplicable for a basis. Using invariant-defined identity bases and explicit effect models, we derive and certify six classification cells in Lean 4 for scope decomposition, rule refinement, and forking. The derivations show how classifications depend on field granularity, admissible transformation steps, and explicit continuity warrants. translated_title: 引用体制：面向中性基底的基于变换的身份特征
translated_abstract: 在法律、制度和分析层面持续存在分歧的环境中运行的数据系统，需要在不预设解释一致的前提下实现共享引用。本文在《中性基底》（Neutral Substrates, arXiv:2601.14271）的条件中立性结果基础上，研究变换下的身份保持问题。我们将候选身份基准与记录变换族配对，并针对每个基准将各变换族分类为保持、破坏、中性或不适用。利用由不变量定义的身份基准和显式效果模型，我们在 Lean 4 中推导并形式化认证了涵盖范围分解、规则细化与分叉的六个分类单元。这些推导表明分类结果如何依赖于字段粒度、可采纳的变换步骤以及显式的连续性保证。我们还刻画了由保持不变量的步骤所生成的身份关系：两个基准当且仅当……时生成相同的关系（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出面向存在持续法律与制度分歧的数据系统的“引用体制”框架，通过在 Lean 4 中形式化认证身份基准与记录变换族之间的六类分类结果，实现了对变换下身份保持、破坏与中性的可验证判定。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes in Lean 4 a referential-regime framework that pairs candidate identity bases with record transformation families—classifying each as preserving, breaking, neutral, or inapplicable—to provide verifiable identity preservation under transformation for data systems that must share references amid persistent interpretive disagreement.
